patch.value: Consume backend-bound reconciliation authority and recovery capabilities

Replace path-bound authoritative document, audit settlement and operation intent access with the shared backend contract. Retain the existing Azure-specific reconciliation design and provider authority.

Use backend-bound authoritative normalized document and version reads, mutation preview, audit lookup, durable operation identity and lease fencing without deriving storage paths.; Refuse unsupported or projection-only authority before local or provider effects; preserve organization/project identity, Azure System.Rev and JSON Patch rev assertions, field constraints and typed relation provenance.; Persist prepared/applied/reconciled recovery identity across ambiguous PATCH success, local commit failure, lease loss and interruption; avoid holding a database transaction across REST I/O while retaining reviewed-version checks.
